developmentalObservation.summary: Lucas demonstrates active communication using early multi-word combinations, prepositions, and direct action demands, while navigating emotional limits during structured interactions.

domains.benchmark_for_age: Stage IV (35-40m): Articles and Regular Past Tense

detailed_observations.insight: Use of prepositions in multi-word phrases
detailed_observations.evidence: Lucas stated, 'Pour on Mama hand.' and 'Squishy, squishy on that one.'
Lucas stated, 'Don't, don't pour it!' and 'No!'

detected_milestone_keys.evidence_summary: Lucas used agent-action and action-object combinations such as 'Mama, open it' and 'Mama, drink water.'
Lucas expressed negation saying 'Don't, don't pour it!' and 'No!'
Lucas used the preposition 'on' in 'Pour on Mama hand.'

detailed_observations.insight: Immediate naming and labeling of present objects/actions
detailed_observations.evidence: Lucas identified attributes and objects saying 'Thumb', 'Squishy, squishy', and 'One'.

detected_milestone_keys.evidence_summary: Lucas labeled immediate items and sensory qualities saying 'Thumb' and 'Squishy, squishy'.

detailed_observations.insight: Initiating interactive play and actions with parent
detailed_observations.evidence: Lucas directed the parent with 'Mama, eat it' and 'Mama, drink water.'

detected_milestone_keys.evidence_summary: Lucas initiated interactions by directing play: 'Mama, drink water' and 'Mama, eat it.'

detailed_observations.insight: Asserting personal boundaries and protesting parent actions
detailed_observations.evidence: Lucas protested parental intervention saying 'No!', 'Don't, don't pour it!', and 'Mama, get out.'

detected_milestone_keys.evidence_summary: Lucas asserted boundaries firmly by exclaiming 'No!' and 'Don't, don't pour it!'

metadata.subject: Lucas
metadata.overall_impression: Lucas engaged in play involving a vitamin bottle and demonstrated direct communication, repetitive requests, and boundary assertions while navigating parental limits.
